planos.01-cenoura: The spoon pushes the carrots slowly to the edge of the plate. Static camera.

planos.03-mae-cansada: The woman sighs, wipes her forehead and looks at the pots. Static camera.
planos.04-vovo-senta: The grandfather sits and joins his hands, smiling warmly. Static camera.

planos.16-kenji-mesa: The boy places a plate on the table, humming and smiling. Static camera.
planos.17-kenji-agradece: The boy bows his head slightly with joined hands, then looks up smiling and talks, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
